title: What If The USA Disappeared For 30 Days? #shorts
format: maps + Dave reacting (Dave always in red hoodie, lower corner, clean poses)

sources.fact: Mexico exported $505.85B to the US in 2024 out of just over $617B total (~82%); the US receives over 80% of all Mexican goods shipped abroad (BBVA Research: 82.7% in Q1 2024)
sources.short: 8 in 10 of Mexico's sales go to the USA

sources.fact: Statistics Canada: by value three-quarters (75.9%) of Canada's domestic exports went to the United States in 2024
sources.short: 3 in 4 of Canada's sales go to the USA

sources.fact: USDA attache report (via MarketsFarm/Grainews, 24 Jun 2025): about 90% of Mexico's corn imports are from the U.S.; later USDA FAS data for Oct 2024-Jul 2025 put US origin at 99%
sources.short: Almost all corn Mexico buys abroad is American

sources.fact: EIA: the US remained the world's largest crude oil producer in 2025 at a record 13.6 million b/d, about 40% more than the next two producers Russia (~9.9M b/d) and Saudi Arabia (~9.6M b/d)
sources.short: USA pumps the most oil; Russia + Saudi are next

sources.fact: IMF COFER data brief: the dollar's share of global FX reserves was 56.70% in 2026Q2; the euro is second at 20.60%
sources.short: Over half of countries' saved money is dollars; euro is no. 2

sources.fact: USDA projections: Brazil holds ~57% of global soybean exports vs ~30% for the US (2024/25) - Brazil is the world's largest soybean exporter
sources.short: Brazil ships the most soybeans on Earth

sources.fact: IMF World Economic Outlook Oct 2026 (via CEOWORLD): world GDP 2026 > $128T; the US at $32.64T is about 25.5% of global GDP
sources.short: 1 in 4 dollars on Earth is made in the USA

beats.say: What if the USA disappeared for thirty days?
Mexico gets hit first because eight out of ten things it sells go to the USA.
Canada too because three out of four of its sales go there.
Worse Mexico loses food too because almost all the corn it buys abroad is American.
Then gas jumps everywhere because the USA pumps more oil than any other country.
So countries lose savings because over half the money they save is American dollars.
Brazil wins because it already ships more soybeans than anyone.
Saudi Arabia and Russia win because every barrel they sell is suddenly worth more.
So Europe steps up because the euro is already the number two savings money.
But nobody wins for long because one in four dollars on Earth is made in the USA.
That is why every country on this map fears one question.
